The Shape of Markdown Output

By A. Maintainer on 2026-01-01.

The first paragraph carries emphasis and a link to the spec. It has to be long enough that the extraction pipeline treats it as a real article rather than a stub, so the sentence keeps going with several more clauses that add nothing but word count for the local extraction threshold.

List behaviour

Unordered lists are the most common structure a markdown converter has to reproduce, and the marker character is precisely the kind of thing a patch release of a converter changes without any functional intent whatsoever.

  • First item with inline code
  • Second item with a nested link
  • Third item that is plain

Ordered lists

Ordered lists drift in the other direction, because some converters emit asterisks and others emit the literal number followed by a parenthesis.

  1. Alpha step
  2. Beta step

A quoted passage that must survive as a quote and not flatten into an ordinary paragraph.
